title: A HEART OF
WHOLE PRAISE
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlight filtering through ancient oak trees
misty meadow at dawn with golden light
peaceful river flowing through a quiet valley
dew on vibrant green leaves at sunrise
soft morning light over rolling hills

scenes.a: If that heavy decision weighing on your mind feels impossible to resolve, stay right here.
I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
scenes.sub: GOD IS WORTHY OF ALL PRAISE

scenes.a: Lord, help me to bring this same sincere devotion into my current circumstances right now.
When my heart feels divided by fear or doubt, remind me of Your unchanging character.
I offer You my full attention today, letting go of the need to control outcomes.
Thank You for the grace that sustains me and for the hope found in Your word.
